scope: Existing DLS Magician Cloud HTML/CSS primitives. This catalog documents implementation; it is not an accessibility certification or a cross-product approval.

components.name: Button
components.description: Action button with the visual variants and sizes used by DLS Magician.
recommendations: Use a native button for actions and a link for navigation.
Give icon-only buttons an accessible name.
Use one visually dominant primary action per decision area.
Check touch targets in the target product: the existing base CSS uses a 38px minimum height.

components.name: Text input
components.description: Single-line input, paired with an explicit label and optional description or error.

variants.error: Enter a task name.

recommendations: Keep the visible label; do not use the placeholder as its replacement.
The error example supplies semantic error markup; there is no dedicated invalid-input visual token in the current CSS.
Validate field text and escape it before inserting it into HTML.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multiline input using the current form-control styles.
recommendations: Keep multiline text vertically resizable.
Associate helper and error text with aria-describedby when present.

components.name: Select
components.description: Native single-choice select with DLS styling.
recommendations: Retain native keyboard behavior and a visible label.
The current select arrow uses appearance:none; verify its rendering in the target browser.

components.name: Status badge
components.description: Neutral badge and draft, review, or published status pills.
recommendations: Keep a visible text label so status is not conveyed by color alone.
Use live-region announcements only when status changes need immediate attention.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Existing modal shell, including header, scrolling body, footer, and width variants.

variants.default:
Create task

Add task details here.
variants.large:
Preview

Preview content
variants.extra-large:
Version history

Version content

recommendations: These are markup examples, not a complete dialog controller.
Implement initial focus, focus trapping, Escape dismissal, background inertness, and focus return in the host application.
Wire Close, Cancel, and primary action handlers before shipping; validate scrolling at narrow widths.

components.name: Flow node
components.description: Structured-language preview node for GIVEN, WHEN, THEN, and AND steps.

variants.default:
GIVEN
A user has a task to complete.
variants.when:
WHEN
They create a task.
variants.then:
THEN
The task is visible in their list.
variants.and:
AND
A confirmation is shown.

recommendations: Use the built-in ds-dls context when matching the DLS preview.
Escape step text as renderFlow does; do not interpolate untrusted text directly into markup.
A flow node is a static preview of a step, not an executable interaction or a completed form.

components.name: Flow connector
components.description: Vertical connector and arrow used between adjacent preview steps.
recommendations: Insert only between adjacent flow nodes.
Keep decorative connectors out of the accessibility tree and preserve step order in the DOM.
